svg.text: Actual 2L b018 copper: geometric reference review; not SI certification
Green = native common GND; pale blue = TOP common copper overlay on reference view; red/blue/purple/orange = USB nets.
All holes/voids retained; oscillator quiet island excluded. Signal paths shown across both outer layers, with BOTTOM translucent.
South7 routing and whole-board DRC pending. Later copper edits require repeat fill/native common/HSE/reference checks.
